conclusions: L3 [0,140,150,160 cm] is the smallest frozen storage representation without reduction-induced aliases through the 1x diagnostic radius in the 41-state common cohort.
L4 and L6 are information-equivalent to L3 in this cohort at every preregistered radius from 0.25x through 4x.
Uniform and near-uniform same-dimension controls retain substantially more hidden state ambiguity and larger purpose-response ambiguity.
L2 remains an informative aggressive challenge but is not a sufficient-state claim.

Prior standard-LARE D3 to D4 dynamics improvement must not be interpreted as evidence that D4 carries more predictive state information in this domain; the immediate unresolved mechanism is closure/resolution.
limitations: candidate-enriched common cohort, not a population-frequency sample
partly exposed predecessor evidence, not blind confirmation
